4: Payment of the WORKER’s wages shall be made semi-monthly not later than 20th day and 5th day of a calendar month following the 1st quincenna and 2nd quincenna, respectively. Anent the budgeting, accounting and auditing rules and regulations, timely payment of wages, is subject to WORKER’s complete submission of the required Payroll’s supporting documents on or before the cut-off date and time (every 16th and 1st working day of the following month at 12:00 noon); otherwise, processing of payment shall proceed upon receipt of complete supporting documents. USTP shall deduct or withhold any and all statutory obligations as may be required by law.
5: Subject to availability of funds as certified by the USTP’s accountant, the WORKER may be paid for work rendered beyond the regular eight (8) hours of duty, after the submission of the following requirements, to wit: 5.1 Approved Request for Extension; 5.2 Accomplishment Report; and 5.3 Latest monthly DTR reflecting the rendered extension.
6: In case of Holiday/s which falls from Monday to Friday, the WORKER may be allowed to render “holiday duty” on the day the holiday falls, subject to the requirements enumerated in the preceding paragraph.
7: In the event when the maximum twenty-two (22) compensable days cannot be availed due to lesser number of working days in a particular month and/or holiday/s, the WORKER may be allowed to render extension of service or “holiday duty”, respectively, on any of the Saturday(s) falling in the calendar month, subject to the requirements enumerated in item 5 of this contract.
8: The PARTIES understood that, this contract does not create an employer-employee relationship between them, that, the services rendered hereunder are not considered and will not be credited as government service, and that, the WORKER, shall not be entitled to ACA and PERA, and other emoluments due to an employee;
9: The WORKER shall maintain strict confidentiality during and after the effectivity of this Contract, any and all information not made available to the public, that are obtained in the course of performance of duties as Job Order worker in compliance with the Republic Act No. 10173 or Data Privacy Act and its Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR);
10: This Contract may be terminated for violation of any provisions hereunder or for just/lawful cause, effective on the 30th day after due receipt of a written notice duly communicated by either party;
11: USTP reserves the right to pre-terminate this Contract immediately and without prior notice to the WORKER, upon Indorsement of the concerned immediate supervisor in any of the following grounds: 11.1 Unsatisfactory Performance of the WORKER. The concerned Immediate Supervisor shall attach the basis for the result of evaluation; 11.2 WORKER’s conduct that is prejudicial to the interest of USTP.
